messages:
Amanda - Cloud Partnerships: Heads up team — LumenModel (open-source, Apache-like) asked about listing on our cloud marketplace + being available in Dedicated/Private. They want guidance on distribution terms and a joint announcement window. Can we align on blockers?
Maya (Legal): Need to confirm exact OSS license text they're using. 'Apache-like' isn't specific enough for redistribution. Also check CLA/third-party deps. Quick Q: will we redistribute weights or pull from their registry?
Jordan - Eng: From infra POV, hosting weights in our object store is fine but we need hash verification and a signed manifest. If we don't host, we'll need a proxy pattern for Dedicated/Private. Also quantization builds: who owns the artifact?
Samir - Product: Important: telemetry & opt-out. Lumen insists on some usage metrics for model improvements. For Dedicated/Private we must offer a fully offline mode and a clear contract that no customer tokens are shared externally.
Alex - Partnerships: Co-marketing ask: Lumen wants a joint blog + Twitter push timed with marketplace listing. They propose a 2-week embargo after we finish integration QA. Any sensitive legal issues with that?
Maya (Legal): Embargo OK but timeline depends on IP clearance. If we host redistributed weights, we need redistribution rights in writing. If it's 'pull from Lumen registry', we need a SLA for availability. I'll draft a short addendum covering redistribution vs passthrough and telemetry consent.
Amanda - Cloud Partnerships: Proposed checklist (rough):
- Confirm license (Maya)
- Confirm hosting model (host vs pull) (Jordan)
- Signed redistribution addendum or registry SLA (Maya/Alex)
- Privacy/telemetry agreement and offline mode (Samir/Maya)
- Packaging/quantization artifacts & owner (Jordan)
- Joint announcement date & asset list (Alex/Amanda)
Can we get owners for each?
Jordan - Eng: I'll own hosting vs pull decision + manifest schema. Quick manifest idea:
```json
{
  "model_name": "lumen-v2",
  "weights_uri": "s3://lumen/releases/lumen-v2.tgz",
  "sha256": "<digest>",
  "quantized_variants": ["int8", "fp16"],
  "license": "LICENSE.txt"
}
```
Amanda - Cloud Partnerships: Thanks. Alex/Amanda will take the announcement + co-marketing assets. Alex?
Alex - Partnerships: I can own the announcement and partner comms. Need legal sign-off on redistribution/registry SLA by EOD Thursday to hit their 2-week slot. Also confirm whether we can include benchmark numbers in the blog (they want perf claims).
Maya (Legal): Benchmarks = advertising claims. We'll need raw data and reproducibility steps before signing off. I'll ping compliance for export control concerns too (weights + tech).
Samir - Product: For telemetry — propose: default off, opt-in during onboarding for hosted tenants; for Dedicated/Private we provide a one-click telemetry agent they can enable. Lumen must promise aggregated, non-identifying metrics.
Amanda - Cloud Partnerships: Nice. Next steps: Maya to draft addendum + checklist by Tue; Jordan to finalize manifest hosting plan by Wed; Alex to prep announcement timeline and request benchmarks. I'll coordinate Lumen kickoff meeting Friday.
announce-bot: Reminder — partnership kickoff scheduled: Friday 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent). :calendar:
Alex - Partnerships: Thanks everyone. If Legal flags redistribution as a no-go we fallback to registry pull + co-marketing only.
Maya (Legal): Noted. I'll prioritize the redistribution clause and flag any export controls ASAP.
Jordan - Eng: One more tech note — if we do hosting, we need a signed SA for storage encryption-at-rest keys and rotation policy. Adding to my list.
Amanda - Cloud Partnerships: Great — I'll share this thread summary with Lumen and ask them to attach their license copy and benchmark logs. Short and actionable. :thumbsup:
Alex - Partnerships: +1. If anyone wants to add a pre-launch checklist item, drop it here before EOD.
